nextStoryContext: US-002 added --install to build-release.sh. The script now: (1) uses a while-loop arg parser, (2) copies dist/cam-darwin-arm64 to a user-owned dest (default ~/.local/bin/cam), (3) strips quarantine, re-signs ad-hoc, and smoke-tests --version.
